latency_protocol.load: local harness concurrency=2 by default, compare only same profile
latency_protocol.production_e2e_absolute_target: pending controlled production-like load baseline; no SLA claim

quality_protocol.fact_precheck: necessary string checks only; not final correctness
quality_protocol.human_review: per-answer facts, conditions, exceptions and evidence; refusals remain in denominator
quality_protocol.split: by knowledge point, 12 tune / 8 test; repetitions inherit parent split
quality_protocol.missing: must refuse without fabricated enterprise facts; service errors are not correct refusals
quality_protocol.conversations: record raw messages in order; baseline uses current single-turn behavior; no oracle query rewriting
quality_protocol.baseline_exit: results frozen and reproducible, old version need not meet future quality thresholds
